caption: The drawing shows a rectangular chest with a hinged lid, depicted in a realistic style with color and texture detailing. The main body of the chest is a light wood color with a subtle, wavy wood grain pattern. The open lid reveals an interior that is a darker brown, indicating a different type or finish of wood inside. The chest sits on four small, round, gold-colored wheels. At the front of the chest, there is a small keyhole. Inside the chest, there appears to be a shallow tray or insert near the top. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there are two smaller, uncolored line drawings showing the chest from a top view and a front view. The artist’s signature, "A. Marsh," is written in purple in the lower right corner of the sheet. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color.
title: Sewing Box
